text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(With the race flowing like this, the 
development should be... As for 
positioning, I'll hold this spot for a 
while...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She went through the inside! She makes her 
move now! And runners from the back are 
closing in as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Not now. Be patient. I'll go at my own 
pace...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Right here!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes!! It's Satono Diamond! 
Unleashing a blistering late burstーー!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond takes 1st!! The diamond has 
shattered every wall in her way—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Allllright! Yes, yes, yeeeeeeeeeeeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan! You did it, Dia-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap... I've got goosebumps...! 
Satono Diamond is seriously strong!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so this is your true strength! Now 
it makes total sense why your runs in the 
Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun felt off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... feel so light... How can they 
be this...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list:
Congrats on 1st place! That was a great 
run!

Congrats on 1st place! That was a great 
run!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you so very much!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, my legs felt so light today! Even 
after finishing my run, I'm not tired at 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To run a race that satisfies even 
myself—!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It felt as if her shackles had been 
broken...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It feels so light...... my body... my 
heart too...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears began to spill from Satono Diamond's 
eyes. And then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!" any

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A raspy, tearful voice echoed through the 
underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family jinx had been whispered 
about since before she was even born. Just 
how heavy a burden must that have been?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps by declaring she wouldn't lose to 
the jinx, she was trying to psych herself 
up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was finally freed from those shackles.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe... *sniff*... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It is just as McQueen-san said. My own 
mind, fretting over jinxes... was holding 
back my own feet all along.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I'm alright now. I won't let myself be 
led astray!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll run my own race just like today, and 
win other GⅠ races too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Not if I have anything to say about it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on winning 1st place in 
the Kikuka Sho, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! That race Kita-chan won last 
year... I won it too! So I can say this 
with my head held high!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan! Race against me in the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: With pleasure!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sounds good, right? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just you be ready, Dia-chan! I'll be a 
whole different beast in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Before I race with Dia-chan, I'm going to 
show the world my running and the heart of 
Japan at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... Let's give it the 
best showdown our current selves can 
offer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, on the way back from Kyoto 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Trainer-san. My heart's been 
pounding all day today♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Even now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about running the Arima 
Kinen with Kita-chan makes my heart race 
uncontrollably. Ah, or maybe it's 
excitement rather than nervousness?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To think that an innocent dream I had as a 
child would actually become reality like 
this...
choice_data_list: A dream where you race with Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the stage I imagined was a GⅠ race. 
But reality turned out to be even more 
dramatic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
On the path toward my dream of becoming a 
renowned Umamusume stands Kita-chan... 
standing firm before me as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"There couldn't be a more fateful and 
thrilling situation than this!"
choice_data_list: This is the greatest stage, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll catch up to Kita-chan who's 
ahead of me, pass her, and make my dream 
come true. My dream, and the dream of the 
Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation in Satono Diamond's 
eyes. The fire burning deep within them 
remains just as bright and fierce as the 
day we first met.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I have no intention whatsoever of 
asking for leniency.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that Dia has overcome the jinx, allow 
me to blow away Kita-chan and all the 
Senior Class racers!
